thread:
Ashley: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we keep seeing short auth provider bursts that precipitate model-registry read failures and then a spike in 5xx on hosted endpoints. Need concrete owners and short timelines.
Morgan: Agree. Is this region-specific? cadence?
Jordi: Traces show bursts ~02:30 UTC and ~14:45 UTC, affecting us-west-2 and eu-west. Correlates with vendor cert rollouts and mass refresh calls.
Priya: Short-term plan: client-side token cache + jittered refresh; fallback read token for registry reads only. Feature-flag both. Owners: SDKs -> Priya, fallback -> Cal. PoC target: 72h.
Cal: Will build fallback behind flag and add a health check endpoint. PoC ETA 72h. Acceptance: during a simulated 1s IdP delay, fallback should keep registry-read success > 97% for 5m.
SRE-Lead: I'll own coordination and runbook edits. Creating ACTION-900..903 to track. Also add synthetic probe hitting auth->registry read; page on >2% errors over 3m.
DevOps-Bot: Actions created: ACTION-900 (fallback-poc), ACTION-901 (synthetic-probe), ACTION-902 (sdk-jitter-prs), ACTION-903 (vendor-engagement).
Morgan: I'll update the runbook and set paging thresholds. ETA 96h.
Priya: I'll open PRs for node/python to add auth.refresh_jitter and auth.cache_ttl defaults. ETA 1 week.
Ashley: I'll lead vendor outreach to request predictable rollout windows and an RCA for recent cert rollouts. ETA 72h for initial contact.
Jordi: Long-term: increase registry read retry backoff cap and add gateway concurrency limits. Owner: Jordi. ETA 2 weeks.
Cal: Also inventory which dedicated/private customers already use local caching; I'll reach out to solutions-eng. ETA 5 days.
SRE-Lead: Next check-in: 3 days at 09:00 UTC. Please update ACTION tickets before then. Escalate blockers in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
Ashley: Thanks all. Keep updates short here and in the ACTION tickets.
